defaults.description: Explore the diverse geography of {name} through our highly optimized, interactive SVG map. Perfect for dashboards, data visualization, and regional targeting.

maps.name: Turkey
maps.description: Turkey is a transcontinental country located mainly on the Anatolian Peninsula in Western Asia, with a smaller portion on the Balkan peninsula in Southeastern Europe, known for its rich history, diverse culture, and strategic location bridging Europe and Asia.

maps.name: Switzerland
maps.description: Switzerland is a landlocked country in Central Europe, renowned for its stunning Alpine landscapes, high quality of life, political neutrality, and status as a global hub for finance and diplomacy.

maps.name: Sweden
maps.description: Sweden is a Nordic country in Northern Europe, known for its vast forests, thousands of coastal islands, progressive social policies, and exceptionally high standard of living.

maps.name: Poland
maps.description: Poland is a country in Central Europe, characterized by its diverse landscape, rich and resilient history, vibrant cultural heritage, and a rapidly growing modern economy.

maps.name: Thailand
maps.description: Thailand is a Southeast Asian country known for its tropical beaches, opulent royal palaces, ancient ruins, and ornate temples displaying figures of Buddha, alongside its world-famous cuisine.

maps.name: Egypt
maps.description: Egypt is a transcontinental country spanning the northeast corner of Africa and southwest corner of Asia, globally famous for its ancient civilization, the Pyramids of Giza, and the historic Nile River.

maps.name: Vietnam
maps.description: Vietnam is a Southeast Asian country known for its stunning natural beauty, including lush rice terraces, bustling cities, rich culinary traditions, and a history shaped by diverse cultural influences.

maps.name: Philippines
maps.description: The Philippines is an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia, comprising over 7,000 islands, celebrated for its beautiful white-sand beaches, rich biodiversity, and warm, hospitable people.

maps.name: Malaysia
maps.description: Malaysia is a Southeast Asian country occupying parts of the Malay Peninsula and the island of Borneo, known for its multicultural society, beautiful beaches, and lush, ancient rainforests.

maps.name: Ukraine
maps.description: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe and the second-largest in Europe by area, known for its fertile plains, rich agricultural heritage, deep historical roots, and resilient national spirit.

maps.name: Colombia
maps.description: Colombia is a South American country known for its incredible biodiversity, vibrant culture, coffee-growing regions, and diverse landscapes ranging from Andean mountains to Caribbean and Pacific coastlines.

maps.name: Chile
maps.description: Chile is a long, narrow country stretching along South America's western edge, famous for its Atacama Desert, Patagonian glaciers, Andes mountains, and world-class wine production.

maps.name: South Africa
maps.description: South Africa is a country at the southern tip of the African continent, renowned for its varied topography, rich cultural diversity, wildlife reserves, and significant historical landmarks.

maps.name: Nigeria
maps.description: Nigeria is a West African country and the most populous in Africa, known for its vibrant cultural heritage, booming film and music industries, and diverse ecosystems from savannas to rainforests.

maps.name: Pakistan
maps.description: Pakistan is a South Asian country featuring dramatic landscapes including the Karakoram and Himalayan mountain ranges, ancient historical sites, and a rich, diverse cultural heritage.

maps.name: Bangladesh
maps.description: Bangladesh is a densely populated South Asian country known for its lush greenery, the vast Ganges-Brahmaputra delta, rich textile history, and vibrant cultural traditions.

maps.name: Iran
maps.description: Iran is a Middle Eastern country with a profound historical legacy, featuring ancient Persian empires, stunning Islamic architecture, and diverse landscapes from arid deserts to snow-capped mountains.

maps.name: UAE
maps.description: The United Arab Emirates is a federation of seven emirates on the Arabian Peninsula, globally recognized for its modern architecture, luxury shopping, and vibrant cultural scene in cities like Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

maps.name: Singapore
maps.description: Singapore is a sovereign island city-state in Southeast Asia, celebrated for its futuristic skyline, strict cleanliness, multicultural population, and status as a major global financial hub.

maps.name: New Zealand
maps.description: New Zealand is an island country in the southwestern Pacific Ocean, famous for its breathtaking natural beauty, including fjords, rolling hills, active volcanoes, and a strong indigenous Māori culture.

maps.name: Ireland
maps.description: Ireland is a lush, green island nation in Northwestern Europe, renowned for its rich literary history, vibrant folklore, welcoming culture, and stunning coastal cliffs.

maps.name: Norway
maps.description: Norway is a Scandinavian country famous for its dramatic fjords, the northern lights, a high standard of living, and a deep cultural connection to nature and maritime history.

maps.name: Israel
maps.description: Israel is a Middle Eastern country on the Mediterranean Sea, known for its profound historical and religious significance, technological innovation, and diverse landscapes from deserts to green valleys.

maps.name: Portugal
maps.description: Portugal is a southern European country known for its historic cities, stunning Atlantic coastline, rich Age of Discovery maritime history, and world-famous Port wine.

maps.name: Greece
maps.description: Greece is a southeastern European country celebrated as the cradle of Western civilization, featuring ancient ruins, thousands of picturesque islands, and a rich Mediterranean culture.

maps.name: Czech Republic
maps.description: The Czech Republic is a landlocked country in Central Europe, renowned for its well-preserved medieval architecture, historic castles, and a deeply rooted brewing tradition.

maps.name: Romania
maps.description: Romania is a country in Eastern Europe known for the forested region of Transylvania, the Carpathian Mountains, the Danube Delta, and its rich folklore and medieval towns.

maps.name: Hungary
maps.description: Hungary is a landlocked country in Central Europe, famous for its historic capital Budapest, extensive thermal bath culture, rich culinary heritage, and the Danube River.

maps.name: Algeria
maps.description: Algeria is the largest country in Africa, located in the Maghreb region, characterized by the vast Sahara Desert, a scenic Mediterranean coastline, and a rich historical heritage.

maps.name: Kazakhstan
maps.description: Kazakhstan is a vast, landlocked country in Central Asia, known for its sweeping steppes, towering mountain ranges, and a blend of rapid modernization with rich nomadic traditions.
